text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
choice_data_list: You don't seem so well, huh.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I've had a slight headache lately...
With the rain continuing, could it be
what they call a weather headache...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...No, this is no time to lose heart!
I'll shatter any jinx and cheerfully—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Ugh.
Is it really impossible to conquer nature...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... Excuse me,
I think I'll lie down for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's always disliked rain.
Her headache is likely compounded by it.
I just hope it clears up soon—
